surface_mechanism_description: The surface reaction mechanism involves the incorporation of Si and N into Ru through plasma-enhanced atomic layer deposition (PEALD) subcycles. The Ru and SiN_x PEALD subcycles were repeated to form RuSiN films. The mechanism includes the use of precursors such as IMBCHRu and TIPAS with NH3 plasma, leading to the formation of RuSiN through surface reactions.
evidence: The text describes the formation of RuSiN films through plasma-enhanced atomic layer deposition (PEALD) with repetitions of supercycles consisting of Ru and SiN_x PEALD subcycles. The surface reactions involved the use of precursors such as IMBCHRu and TIPAS with NH3 plasma, leading to the formation of RuSiN through surface reactions. The microstructure of the RuSiN film was found to consist of Ru nanocrystals embedded in a SiN_x amorphous matrix.
